newsitem.title: USA: Shaw Group changes ticker symbol.
newsitem.headline: Shaw Group changes ticker symbol.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Shaw Group Inc's common shares would begin trading on the exchange under the symbol SGR.N on Friday.
The Louisanna-based company, which used to trade on the over-the-counter market under the symbol, was originally going to change its symbol to PIP.N, then changed its mind, the exchange said.
Shaw Group supplies industrial piping systems for new construction and retro-fit projects, moslty for the electric power, refining and chemical industries.
